script:
"I basically had the biggest panic attack after she told me Angela was calling a wellfare check after we had told her Sarah was able to calm me down from one of the worst panic attacks I’ve had. I collected myself and then told my kids that a police officer would be stopping by and that everything would be okay to just go play upstairs they wouldn’t be there long."

"Angela, you know that picture of Lin sent to me was because I asked him to show me the proof of it. Not him just willingly spreading around this picture... I was also sending you because I trusted you that it wouldn't come back that I sent it to you... It wasn’t him spreading around Lin’s nude. She did that herself. It was literally to reassure me she wasn’t nude like I thought she was. Framing it as if he was going around spreading the picture just isn’t what happened... Like, at all."

"What friend weaponizes that when I'm coming to you TALKING about me being insecure about it?!? How are you going to now lay it out like it’s some sick pass around the nudes of people? ... Lin has stated that shit was made public by her, she willingly spread it around. And then went up and defended Logan that he WASNT spreading it. He was showing his girlfriend she wasn't nude she was in lingerie."

"Thats old news apparently hes shared nudes a bunch with his close friends."

"He sent me a nude video of a girl in the community (I don't believe I have evidence for that) and he produced a nude AI image of a woman in the community."
